budget.notes: Marc is open to €30–50/month if the ROI is clear. Beyond €100/month, a strong justification would be needed.

founder_capabilities: Edit an email template in a no-code interface
Add a row to a rules table
Understand a visual workflow without writing code
Manage credentials in a simple interface
founder_limits: Does not want to manage server infrastructure

deployer.name: Romain
deployer.availability: On request, responds within 24h, can start in 1–2 days
capabilities: Can configure n8n, manage API credentials
Can write a simple JavaScript Code node

compliance.existing_compliance_processes: GDPR notices on the website, no formal DPO

deployment_context.notes: Marc wants to be able to edit templates and add rules himself. Initial deployment will be done by Romain. Day-to-day maintenance must be accessible to Marc without assistance.

builder_rationale: n8n Community Edition (self-hosted or cloud) fits the profile exactly: visual workflow, native Gmail + Google Sheets nodes, free when self-hosted or ~€20/month on cloud. Interface accessible for minor edits by Marc. Romain can deploy and configure in 4–6h.
